features.name: Core Mapping Integration
features.description: Integrate with Google Maps Platform for interactive maps with custom vehicle markers, zoom/pan controls, marker clustering, real-time updates, alternative provider support (Mapbox, OpenStreetMap), responsive rendering, map tile caching, and graceful failure handling

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to view available vehicles on an interactive map, so that I can visually discover vehicles near my location or destination
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate with Google Maps Platform for mapping services
Display interactive maps with custom markers for vehicle locations
Support map zoom, pan, and marker clustering for dense areas
Use custom marker icons to differentiate vehicle types (sedan, SUV, van)
Display vehicle details in popup when user clicks marker
Update vehicle markers in real-time as availability changes
Support alternative mapping providers (Mapbox, OpenStreetMap) for cost optimization
Render maps responsively on mobile and desktop devices
Cache map tiles for improved performance
Handle mapping service failures gracefully with fallback to cached data

features.name: Marketing Email Integration
features.description: Integrate with marketing email platform (Mailchimp, SendGrid Marketing, Brevo) for promotional campaigns with customer list segmentation, campaign builder, A/B testing, tracking metrics (open/click/conversion rates), honoring unsubscribe requests, maintaining do-not-email list, automated workflows, GDPR compliance, and analytics dashboard

requirementDetails.userStory: As a marketing team member, I want to send promotional campaigns to customers, so that I can drive engagement and bookings through targeted offers
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate with marketing email platform (Mailchimp, SendGrid Marketing, Brevo)
Support customer list segmentation by booking history, location, preferences
Provide campaign builder with template management
Support A/B testing for email campaigns
Track email open rates, click rates, and conversion rates
Honor unsubscribe requests immediately (within 10 business days per CAN-SPAM)
Maintain do-not-email list and check before sending
Support automated email workflows (welcome series, abandoned booking)
Comply with GDPR consent requirements for EU customers
Provide analytics dashboard for campaign performance

features.name: SMS Notification Integration
features.description: Integrate with SMS gateway (Twilio, Vonage, AWS SNS) for booking confirmations, pickup reminders (24h and 1h before), vehicle ready notifications, 2FA codes, international delivery, delivery receipt tracking, 160-character optimization, sender identification, clear opt-out instructions, immediate opt-out honoring, explicit opt-in for marketing, and TCPA compliance

workflowContext.workflow: Booking Creation Workflow, Vehicle Pickup Workflow

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to receive text messages for time-sensitive notifications, so that I don't miss important updates about my booking
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate with SMS gateway provider (Twilio, Vonage, AWS SNS)
Send SMS for booking confirmations with booking reference
Send SMS reminder 24 hours before pickup
Send SMS reminder 1 hour before pickup
Send SMS when vehicle is ready for pickup
Send SMS for two-factor authentication codes
Support international SMS delivery
Track SMS delivery receipts
Keep SMS messages under 160 characters when possible
Include sender identification in all SMS messages
Provide clear opt-out instructions in SMS (e.g., 'Reply STOP to unsubscribe')
Honor opt-out requests immediately
Obtain explicit opt-in consent before sending marketing SMS
Comply with TCPA regulations for US customers

features.name: Mobile Push Notification Integration
features.description: Integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for Android and Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) for iOS to send push notifications for booking status changes, payment confirmations, pickup reminders, with rich notifications, deep linking, delivery tracking, notification grouping, customizable preferences, quiet hours respect, permission handling, silent notifications, and A/B testing

requirementDetails.userStory: As a mobile app user, I want to receive push notifications for booking updates, so that I stay informed about my rental in real-time
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for Android push notifications
Integrate Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) for iOS push notifications
Send push notification for booking status changes
Send push notification for payment confirmations
Send push notification for pickup reminders
Support rich notifications with images and action buttons
Implement deep linking to relevant app screens from notifications
Track notification delivery and engagement metrics
Support notification grouping and threading
Allow users to customize notification preferences in app settings
Respect device notification settings and quiet hours
Handle notification permission denial gracefully
Support silent notifications for background data updates
Implement A/B testing for notification content

features.name: Web Push Notification Integration
features.description: Implement web push notifications using service workers with permission request, booking confirmations and updates, rich notifications with images/actions, deep links to relevant pages, desktop and mobile browser support, browser settings respect, engagement tracking, opt-out mechanism, and graceful permission denial handling

requirementDetails.userStory: As a web user, I want to receive browser notifications for booking updates, so that I stay informed without needing the mobile app
acceptanceCriteria: Implement web push notifications using service workers
Request notification permission with clear value proposition
Send web push for booking confirmations and updates
Support rich notifications with images and actions
Handle notification clicks with deep links to relevant pages

Respect browser notification settings

features.name: Webhook Integration for Delivery Status
features.description: Configure webhook endpoints for each notification provider, verify webhook signatures, process delivery confirmation webhooks, process bounce/complaint/unsubscribe event webhooks, update notification status in database, trigger follow-up actions based on events, log all webhook events for audit, and handle duplicate webhook events gracefully

sources.section: Requirement 12: Webhook Integration for Delivery Status

acceptanceCriteria: Configure webhook endpoints for each notification provider

Process bounce notification webhooks

Log all webhook events for audit
Handle duplicate webhook events gracefully
